documents.title: Initial window report
body: CALICHE DISPATCH / INITIAL REPORT. SARO control-room window, outside face of glass. Reyes reports a moving hand or forearm. Identity not established. Exterior marks are a separate physical check and are not certified by this first call.
The incident time and caller's location are copied from the actual call log and read back. This report does not establish a relief dispatch or a missing person.
documents.production_nb: Adapter må sette faktisk in-game dato/tid/sted fra første meldingslogg. Ingen oppdiktet permanent klokkeslett.

documents.title: Caliche Junction encounter note
body: The completed local lamp check remains recorded on its service card. Physical return filing at SARO is a separate action. At the service front a pale body moved under direct observation and turned towards new sound.
Reyes used the available route outside the fence, reached SARO 07 and broke contact. This note does not identify the body or explain the lamp fault.
documents.production_nb: Bare faktisk vellykket flukt. Lokal retry gir ikke denne før ny vellykket retrett.

documents.title: District relief dispatch receipt
body: CALICHE DISPATCH / RELIEF REQUEST. Reports at SARO and Caliche Junction linked under the current incident reference.
Regional technician Mara Ortiz, district wagon 23, assigned to meet Reyes at the public Caliche fuel stop. Actual dispatch time and contact readback attached.
This is an assignment record. It is not proof of arrival, abduction or a missing-person filing.
documents.production_nb: Reell utkalling har egen dato/tid/ID fra adapter. Ny person/vogn må produseres.

documents.title: Wagon 23: observed traces
body: After reaching cover, Reyes checked the empty district wagon, the thermos on the asphalt and the marks in the gravel beside it. Tape on the thermos names Mara Ortiz.
The trace note records what remained. The separately witnessed lift and the subsequent missing-person report have their own records.
documents.production_nb: Faktiske navngitte rekvisitter (vogn, termos, merker i grusen) må finnes; ikke løft-credit fra bare objekter.

documents.title: Mara Ortiz: missing-person receipt
body: CALICHE DISPATCH / MISSING PERSON. Mara Ortiz, district maintenance, last seen at the public Caliche fuel stop beside wagon 23.
Reyes reports seeing Ortiz rise clear of support in an external light and then disappear. Dispatch has read back identity, place and actual report time, and linked the relief assignment.
Search assigned to the sheriff's office; the deputy is sent to the fuel stop. This report does not explain the disappearance.
documents.production_nb: Dynamisk hendelses-ID/dato/tid fra faktisk savnetmelding, adskilt fra utkallingskvittering.

documents.title: SARO local morning-series hold
body: DR. WARD / LOCAL WORK ORDER. SARO 06:00 observer series suspended after the Caliche missing-person report.
Dispatch owns the search for Mara Ortiz. Reyes is to remain at an established contact point. This order is local to SARO; network action requires later independent evidence.
Physical automatic-schedule isolation has its own check and must not be inferred from this order.
documents.production_nb: Bare faktisk Ward-ordre/readback. Ingen nettverkskvittering eller fysisk bryterstatus fra tekst alene.

documents.title: Local automatic schedule: isolated
body: The physical auto/survey schedule has been placed in its marked isolated state and checked locally. Passive reception remains available.

Secured for the missing-person report: the receiver log and strip chart covering 21:00, the dated shift journal and the T01 service card. T01 is filed with them, once. A separately authorised bounded array check remains possible; unattended operation stays suspended.
documents.production_nb: Ekte betjening/kontroll og papirhenting. T01-arkiveringen skjer her én gang (EveningShifts eksisterende filing). Ingen avbryting av all strøm eller K3 som global bryter.

documents.title: 1420 AM: identified original-source check
body: Identified 1981 off-air reel and separately preserved local log examined at 1420 AM. Source switch checked in isolated TAPE and LIVE MONITOR paths; the unused input was disconnected in each test.
The reel repeated the same fragment after a new question. The result establishes this playback's dated source and fixed content. It does not measure a bearing or identify the original sound.
1420 AM is distinct from the SARO receiver at 1420.405 MHz. Field geometry needs operator positions and fixed landmarks.

documents.title: 1420 AM: checked dated source copy
body: Earl's labelled collection envelope contains a copy identified to the 1981 off-air reel, its dated local log and a playback/disconnection sheet.
After Earl left, Reyes used the isolated lobby deck and checked the copy's fixed fragment against a new question. This is a verified copy-source path, not an examination of the original reel.
No bearing or present location follows from the audio. Earl did not answer after his departure.

documents.title: Array service comparison
body: Separate command and drive record checked for the identified Row One near group. Fixed reference lamp left at REF / R1 at unchanged setting. The ordinary service card is EV_DALE_ARRAY_SERVICE; T02's culvert index remains separate.

Operator chose A / ROW 1 WEST or B / ROW 1 EAST first, moved to the other and briefly returned. Observed dish angles changed with those physical positions against fixed landmarks; the lamp stayed at REF / R1.
The selected route, local timings and actual observations belong in the field record. Audio supports sequence and timing, not bearing. This check does not establish identity, C or Nora's motive.

documents.title: Old Roswell road: route and courier readback
body: Caliche deputy's dated patrol sheet: north road and old Roswell road driven at 03:30, no obstruction recorded. Ward entered its time in her log. One drive is not proof of future safe passage.
After mapping C at bolt 8.15, Reyes agreed a courier handover at bolt 10.4 beyond it. Plan: carry the originals, pass C without stopping or taking another reading.
The warning, three source IDs and the first boundary time are already read back outside SARO. The diner remains a refuge; the handover keeps the source chain and is not another observer experiment.
